flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/NoticeSearch/{form/NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx,list/NoticeSearchAllList.tsx} (generic staff notice search). Other repos: no summon-witness code.
note: Story status is User Story Removed; the verdict stays Removed even though similar code exists. Only the generic staff Notice Search exists (search by id_no, notice_no and summon_no). There is no summon-witness application function or menu. Searched synonyms witness, summon witness, State Courts, court mention, section of law, investigation officer, SummonWit, ocms_summon, ocms_court_mention across the six repos (UI and API, stale cronservice ignored): no hit related to a summon-witness application.

steps.step: Officer opens the witness summons application function
steps.detail: No menu, route or page for a summon-witness application. Synonyms searched: witness, summon witness, State Courts, SummonWit, ocms_summon; zero hits in UI and API. witness_po_id in ocmsadminui/src/utils/mapping/NoticeUPL.ts:395 is only a UPL (warden) field, not a witness application.

steps.step: Officer searches by ID number, summons number or notice number
steps.detail: The generic Notice Search form has id_no (NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx:542), summon_no (:438) and notice_no (:64) inputs and queries resource validoffencenoticelist. This is the general staff notice search, not part of a summon-witness application flow. Whether the summon_no filter is really handled on the server: cannot verify from repo (no summon controller in the six repos; only a /v1/summon mapping in ocmsadminapi/src/main/resources/api-authorization.properties:23). Story Removed, so Sebagian.

Search results are shown in a Datagrid with notice_no and summon_no columns (NoticeSearchAllList.tsx:139-141). This is a generic notice list, not a list of summonses for a witness application. Story Removed, so Sebagian.
